Sightline didn't start.

If this file is in OneDrive or another synced folder, wait for the sync to finish, then reload. A file that's still arriving looks changed to the browser.

Otherwise, the page's code was blocked, which usually means this file changed while it was being copied: for example, pasted as text through a remote desktop, or opened and saved in an editor.

Copy sightline.html again as a file (OneDrive, or drag and drop), then reload. To check a copy, run sha256sum -c sightline.html.sha256 in the same folder: it should say OK.

If the browser's console says "Content Security Policy", that's this problem. Your plan file is not affected.

Forecast

Worked out from effort, who's in each workstream, their time and what each item waits for. It never moves anything on the timeline.

Time off

Everyone's time off in one place. Company holidays are in Settings → Calendar.

Jira users

People load

Active items per person per week. Amber = 2, red = 3+. Waiting items don't count.

Dates and scheduling

Jira connection, tags and the planning guide have their own pages in Settings.

People

Owners are picked from this list. Working days per week and time off feed people load, and a person's time off pushes their tasks out, like a holiday.

Groups

Groups let you add several people to a meeting at once. Changing a group updates every meeting that uses it.

Skills

What people are good at and what work needs, in the team's own words. Give people skills on their card, and work its needs on its card. Your assistant reads both, as labels, not proof.

Baseline

The baseline is the plan as it was when you set it. Once it's set, moved items show a dashed outline and how far they slipped.

Ceremonies

Meetings that happen every sprint (planning, review, retro). Each follows a sprint rule, like "the last day of every sprint". To move or skip one just for a crisis, click it on the chart.

Process blocks

Your own building blocks: code freeze, release, hardening, demo day. Give a type a sprint rule ("the 3rd-last working day of every sprint") and there's one every sprint, which you can move or skip just for that sprint.

Meetings on the plan

One-off or repeating. Meetings on holidays are skipped. They show on the timeline in a Meetings row, and in each attendee's row in the Days view.

Timeboxes

Jira's sprints, then the plan's own timeboxes after them, back to back from the start date. A Jira sprint's name and dates follow Jira; change a timebox's length for holidays or a longer one.

Holidays

Holidays are working days nobody has. Anything that spans one (tasks and initiatives) ends a day later, and sprints show how many working days they really have. Waiting blocks don't change.

Milestones

Pick a workstream and a date to put a milestone on the chart. A stretch date draws a dashed marker. You can also hover the chart and click +.
